name: ca77y-engineering
description: Idea-to-shipped development pipeline as Claude Code subagents: analyst (shapes stories + records cards), the lead skill (run in the main session, it takes one task from a prompt or a story card to a single PR — no splitting, no merging, dispatching the workers flat and driving the PR review loop), the board skill (helps a project write or repair the ISSUE_TRACKING.md declaration that every board-touching agent reads directly, at a fixed path, with no per-run resolution step), writer (authors the task's spec, then its docs), coder (builds the whole task), qa (the lead's validation and independent local code review of the build), auditor (the spec-readiness gate, the acceptance gate, plus the analyst's story advisor). Deep research and the project's Markdown research library live in the companion ca77y-library plugin — the analyst uses its librarian and clerk when they are installed, and works from the wiki pages directly when they are not.
